notes: Multiplayer: after a game over the whole team stays together and the next game starts by itself in 10 seconds
Anyone can tap PLAY AGAIN to start sooner; LEAVE is now a small button in the corner
If a friend's phone loses the connection, it rejoins the same room on its own, no code needed
Multiplayer! Play with up to 3 friends: HOST GAME on one phone, JOIN GAME with its code on the others
More players means more enemies, tougher enemies and a much tougher boss
Each player has their own hearts, powers, upgrades and gems
Go down and you're back next round; the game ends when the whole team is down
Solo play works just like before
Gear from the shop now works like a pickup: it turns on when the next round starts and lasts 10 seconds
Gear is cheaper to match
Shop now has a GEAR tab: start rounds with Spread, Rapid or the new Laser
Gear also has Force Field, Buddy Drone, Power Pack and Gem Doubler
New upgrades: Lucky Shot, Field Medic, Power Surge, Overcharge (no limit)
Higher caps on Firepower, Trigger Finger and Armor
Fewer random drops, more gems, so you choose your power-ups
Fixed late rounds where the last enemies got stuck outside the arena and the round never ended
A different boss for every arena:
Sludge Queen (Toxic Dome): acid lobs, burning puddles, slimes
Cryo Sentinel (Frost Rink): ice spirals and charges; hit it while it's dazed
Magma Titan (Inferno): meteors and fire rings with a gap to slip through
Version number and these release notes show when the game opens
Updates install themselves between games, so you never lose a run
Power, pause and mute buttons moved beside the arena, out of the way
New arena look every 5 rounds
Pillar layouts you can use as cover
Round twists: Swarm, Ambush, Minefield, Lights Out and more
Zoomed bubble shows your guy when your thumb covers him
Bigger characters, easier to hit
Nothing hidden behind the iPhone camera or home bar
First release
